facts.label: Aula de desenho
facts.sub: Use comparativos para comparar e should para aconselhar: The face is bigger than the body. You should make the head smaller.

facts.label: Mais … que
facts.sub: Com adjetivos curtos, use -er + than: big vira bigger, easy vira easier. A professora diz The face is bigger than the body. Para good, use better; para bad, use worse.

facts.label: More + adjetivo
facts.sub: Com adjetivos longos, use more: more beautiful, more difficult. Diga Your tree is more beautiful than your house. Nunca junte more com -er, como more easier.

pages.title: A drawing class · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday evening in a drawing class in Cardiff. Soft light comes from a big lamp. Ben holds a pencil over his sketchbook. His teacher Alma stops behind him. She looks at the lines and the shapes. She has some advice for him.
“Hi, Ben! Your drawing is nice, but the face is bigger than the body.” says Alma. “Oh, you’re right. Please help me.” says Ben. “You should make the head smaller.” says Alma.
